submissionRule: If any release functionality is restricted by login, membership, geography, wallet state, subscription or other authentication, provide Google Play with durable reusable review access and English instructions. Never provide a production user's credentials.
reviewerNotesDraft: WorldzApp is non-custodial. Reviewers do not need to provide a seed phrase or private key.
Public modules and security status can be inspected without connecting a wallet.
Wallet connection is optional and currently used for public address/network association only.
Gated treasury actions must be described as gated and must not be represented as executable when they are not.
